title: openai-compat: support Responses API seed/determinism and metadata passthrough for streaming/tools/structured-output
author: Liam O'Connor
release_notes: Add seed/determinism flags and passthrough of user-provided response metadata to OpenAI-compatible Responses endpoints; stabilize streaming path for structured output and tool-calling. Backwards-compatible; no API surface breaking changes.
commits: feat(responses): add seed/determinism params and metadata passthrough
fix(streaming): handle partial metadata frames and reassembly
test: add unit + integration tests for Responses compatibility
docs: document new flags and migration notes
description:
Motivation: the OpenAI Responses API has broadened with seed/determinism controls and richer response-level metadata. Customers using the OpenAI compatibility layer expect passthrough of metadata (user-provided fields) and deterministic seeding for reproducible outputs. This PR adds first-class support for `seed` and `determinism` query/body flags on Responses-compatible endpoints, ensures user-provided `metadata` is preserved and surfaced in streamed frames, and hardens the streaming reassembly logic so structured-output and tool/function-calling remain stable when metadata frames are interleaved.

What changed: implemented parameter parsing and validation in the responses adapter, plumbing seed/determinism through the serving runtime, added metadata passthrough hooks that attach user metadata to both final response objects and streaming delta frames, and updated streaming frame parsing to tolerate split metadata chunks. Added unit and integration tests exercising streaming reassembly, structured output + function-calling combos, and determinism reproducibility checks. Updated docs with examples and migration notes.

Checklist: [x] add adapter param handling [x] forward params to runtime [x] preserve metadata in both streaming and non-streaming flows [x] tests added [x] docs updated [x] perf/regression checks run.

Testing & rollout: ran full unit suite and the Responses e2e suite against dedicated staging; CI flake observed in e2e (streaming) was rerun and passed. Perf canary shows <1% median token-latency regression at typical batch sizes; no cost regressions observed. Rollout plan: staged release to beta customers for 48h, then general rollout with feature flag off by default.

Related: Linear ENG-9421 / ENG-9582; support ticket SUP-2201.
review_comments: Priya: Can you confirm behavior when both seed and temperature are provided? Is determinism vs seed precedence documented?
Author (Liam): Seed wins for deterministic runs; if seed present and determinism unset we treat determinism=true for that request. Added explicit note in docs and unit tests to cover the precedence.
Ethan: Found a case where streaming frames split a metadata JSON object across two TCP frames; suggested reassembly test.
Author (Liam): Added a reassembly test and improved the streaming parser to buffer metadata frames until they form valid JSON. Added metrics to track partial-frame reassembly failures.
Priya: LGTM after minor doc clarification.
